title: Legacy program as a dummy program that keeps physicists out

tellings.quote: But an alternate hypothesis is that this is a dummy program masking something. And the last thing that you would want ever on such a program is a physicist.

plain: A secret "legacy program" at an old aerospace company, said to hold recovered craft, might be a fake meant to hide something else, says a researcher named Eric Weinstein. He tells Michels the "alternate hypothesis" is that it is "a dummy program masking something," and that "the last thing that you would want ever on such a program is a physicist," since a physicist might see through it. He offers it as a guess, not as something he was told.
